title: Biomed International Products Corp.
description:
Sector: Medical and health professionals, and related clinical and counseling institutions | Location: 102-3738 North Fraser Way Burnaby, BC, Canada | Employees: 11-50 | Revenue: $5 million | Website: https://biomedicine.com/ | Deadline: 2026-11-17 08:00 UTC
Biomed International Products Corp. is a Canadian company based in Burnaby, British Columbia, that supplies professional-grade nutritional supplements and natural health products to healthcare practitioners. The company also provides product education, webinars, and practitioner support.
